task.description:
Update documentation for API-05 release.

1. Update CHANGELOG.md with API-05 entry:
   - Stage 4: Added GET /instances/:id/history endpoint
   - Supports event_type, from/to timestamp filters
   - Cursor-based pagination per API-06
   - Includes archived events (ES-07) via UNION ALL
   - 22 unit tests, all passing

2. Verify requirement_status.json has API-05 at RELEASED (should already be set by RELEASE-VALIDATOR)

3. Run retrospective if estimation.json exists for this run:
   - Read handoffs/WF02-api05-20260523/estimation.json
   - Compute actual work time per step from started_at/completed_at
   - Compare estimated vs actual
   - Write docs/metrics/retrospectives/WF02-api05-20260523.json

result.summary: Updated CHANGELOG.md with API-05 entry (Stage 4: History endpoint, GET /instances/:id/history). Verified API-05 at RELEASED in requirement_status.json. Ran retrospective: computed actual times, identified timestamp anomalies in code-designer and backend-dev steps (started_at > completed_at), triggered rule adjustments for test-runner (D2: 4->3) and release-validator (D2: 4->2) based on 3+ consecutive runs with >25% variance.

issues.description: Timestamp inconsistency in code-designer and backend-dev handoffs: started_at (May 23) > completed_at (May 22). Likely ORCH used future dates for created_at/started_at while agents ran on May 22 and set correct completed_at. Retrospective marks these steps as actual=null.
